Team —

Attached is the first pass risk heatmap for the Q4 launch (Q4_Launch_Risk_Heatmap_v1.xlsx) and a short enablement readiness summary. I pulled inputs from last week's syndicate and the enablement working group; this is intentionally a lean view so we can make decisions quickly.

Asking: please review the sheet and do two things by EOD today:
- Update the "Owner" cell for any row you are responsible for (column D).
- Add a short comment in the "Mitigation" column for any risk you can materially reduce before launch (column F).

Top-level guidance: anything with a residual risk >= 8 (likelihood * impact) we must either mitigate or plan fallback for the go-live window. I want the executive summary (top 3 risks + owners + go/no-go recommendation) for the exec QBR by 10/01 COB.

Notes / constraints:
- Pricing guardrails need a final review from Karthik (see pricing-guardrails.docx) — this affects deal-specific discounts and the NimbleHealth pilot.
- Support runbook is in draft; Kimberly, I put the latest comments inline.
- Docs: Laura, I referenced the consolidated playbook link in related_links — please confirm which customer-facing assets are still outstanding.

Attachments: Q4_Launch_Risk_Heatmap_v1.xlsx, enablement-readiness-summary.pdf

Thanks,
Vivek

Subject: Launch Go/No-Go: Risk Heatmap + Owner Assignments (Q4) — Consolidated Owners & Next Steps

Team — great updates; thank you. Consolidated summary and explicit owners so execs get a crisp readout tomorrow morning:

Top 3 residual risks (post-mitigation)
1) Enablement: missing demo + playbook bundle (Residual Risk = 9) — Owner: Marissa Cole — Mitigation: prioritize final recording (10/03) and deliver one-pager for pilots (10/01 EOD).
2) SLA / legal: retention & access window for NimbleHealth (Residual Risk = 8) — Owner: Monica Patel — Mitigation: Monica to coordinate with security/legal and provide redline language to Alex by 10/01 4pm PT.
3) Pricing guardrail exceptions impacting revenue accounting (Residual Risk = 7) — Owner: Karthik Iyer — Mitigation: Karthik to confirm discount threshold and provide conditional clause for DocuSign by 10/01 COB.

Other items:
- Docs: Laura to confirm Customer Quickstart sign-off (10/02) and push final API docs PR (target 10/04).
- Support: Kimberly to finalize rollback steps and publish runbook (10/01 AM).
- Sales ops: Marissa to provide final playbook bundle and enablement assets (10/01 EOD).

To Alex's questions:
- We will launch behind a feature flag and run a staged rollout for NimbleHealth for the first 48 hours; that will be our default fallback.
- Monica will draft the SLA wording. For now expect a pilot-specific retention clause and an access window that is narrower than our standard enterprise terms; we'll surface exact language in the DocuSign packet.

I'll assemble the exec QBR slide (top risks + owners + recommendation) after I see updates at 10/01 5pm PT. If any item cannot meet the mitigation ETA, mark the heatmap cell and call it out in the comments — we'll escalate as needed.

Attachments: owners_rundown.csv

Thanks — Vivek
